_comment: Areas of interest (AOIs) for satellite analysis. Keep AOIs small: imagery is downloaded only for these boxes. bbox = [min_lon, min_lat, max_lon, max_lat] in WGS84.

aois.name: Navi Mumbai (Ulwe / Panvel creek)
aois.label: DEMO AOI
aois.purpose: Demonstration AOI chosen because large-scale construction (Navi Mumbai International Airport site) and tidal creeks are present. What the change engine reports is computed from the imagery; nothing is pre-labelled.

imagery.provider: Earth Search by Element 84 (AWS Open Data: Sentinel-2 L2A COGs)
